notes.content: LIBERAL STUDIES, B.A. TEACHING AND LEARNING EMPHASIS

1. Access the University Catalog for Programs and Degrees, General Education Requirements, and Graduation Requirements at CSUCI. 2. Access the Admissions website for CSUCI admission requirements. 5. It is recommended to review the applicable department agreement(s) in addition to the major agreement and that students meet with a counselor/academic advisor early and often during their academic career.

notes.content: 1. GPA Requirement: Students who plan to enter a teaching credential program in California will be required to have a cumulative GPA of 2.67 OR a 2.75 GPA in the last 60 units of their baccalaureate degree to be eligible for admission to the post-baccalaureate credential program. 2. Please visit the School of Education website for more information about applying to the credential program. 3. Required Liberal Studies Concentration: 9 additional units must be taken from one of the following concentrations: 1. Art Concentration 2. Bilingualism and Biliteracy Concentration (Requires upper-division courses only) 3. Computer Science Concentration 4. Dance Concentration (Requires upper-division courses only) 5. English Concentration (Requires upper-division courses only) 6. Ethnic Studies Concentration 7. Health Science Concentration 8. History and Social Science Concentration (Requires upper-division courses only) 9. Human Development and Psychology Concentration 10. Mathematics Concentration (Requires upper-division courses only) 11. Music Concentration 12. Science Concentration 13. Theater Concentration 4. Lower division courses may be substituted with transferable community college courses. Students should work with their Liberal Studies Faculty Advisor to identify the courses that may be used to meet concentration requirements. 5. Those concentrations that do require or allow lower division courses are listed below: 1. The following applies to the Art Concentration: complete a minimum of 9 units of art courses, at least 6 of the 9 units must be upper division. 2. The following applies to the Computer Science Concentration section below: complete a minimum of 9 units of computer science courses. COMP 105 is required. Students must complete 6 additional units, either lower division or upper division. 3. The following applies to the Ethnic Studies Concentration section below: complete a minimum of 9 units of ethnic studies courses. CHS 160 and 349 are required. Complete 3 additional units of upper-division Chicana/o Studies or Black Studies courses. 4. The following applies to the Health Science Concentration section below: complete 9 units of health science courses. HLTH 101 is required. Complete 6 additional units of health science courses, 3 must be upper division. 5. The following applies to the Human Development and Psychology Concentration: complete a minimum of 9 units of psychology courses, at least 6 of the 9 units must be upper division. 6. The following applies to the Music Concentration section below: complete a minimum of 9 units of music courses. MUSIC 161 and MUSIC 332 are required. Complete a minimum 3 upper-division units of music courses. 7. The following applies to the Science Concentration: students are strongly encouraged to take courses from at least two different science disciplines (e.g.: biology, chemistry, geology, physics, etc.). Complete a minimum of 9 units of science courses, at least 6 of the 9 units must be upper division. 8. The following applies to the Theater Concentration: complete a minimum of 9 units of theater courses. At least 6 of the 9 units must be upper-division courses.
